title: Spatial Ensemble Logic for Biomedical Imaging: Geometric Element Ensembles in Euclidean Space
abstract: arXiv:2611.29105v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Ensemble Logic (EL) is a family of modal logics over metric monoids whose modal parameters are terms with quantified variables. We study its member over the Euclidian space, called Spatial Ensemble Logic (SEL), for biomedical images. Geometric element ensembles (GELs) represent atomic propositions by finite lists of effectively presented semi-algebraic sets, principally closed balls. Translation, dilation and erosion preserve individual balls up to emptiness in any dimension. Translation and dilation act element-wise, but element-wise erosion gives only an inner bound. For $k\geq 2$, finite unions of balls are closed under neither intersection nor erosion. We therefore separate record representation from the evaluation domain. Our main result is a satisfaction-preserving translation over GELs into the first-order theory of real closed fields. translated_title: 用于生物医学成像的空间集成逻辑：欧几里得空间中的几何元素集成
translated_abstract: 集成逻辑是一类定义在度量幺半群上的模态逻辑，其模态参数是带有量化变量的项。我们研究了其在欧几里得空间上的一个成员，称为空间集成逻辑（SEL），应用于生物医学图像。几何元素集成通过有限个可有效表示的半代数集合（主要是闭球）的列表来表示原子命题。在任意维度上，平移、膨胀和腐蚀均能保持单个球的性质（直至空集）。平移和膨胀按元素逐个作用，但逐元素的腐蚀只能给出内界。对于 k≥2，球的有限并集在交集运算和腐蚀运算下均不封闭。因此，我们将记录表示与求值域相分离。我们的主要结果是一个保持满足性的翻译，将 GEL 上的公式翻译到实闭域的一阶理论中。该翻译产生了可计算的半代数满足集、可判定的模型检测以及有限的（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了用于生物医学成像的空间集成逻辑（SEL），通过将几何元素集成上的公式保持满足性地翻译为实闭域的一阶理论，实现了半代数满足集的可计算性和模型检测的可判定性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Spatial Ensemble Logic (SEL) for biomedical imaging, achieving computable semi-algebraic satisfaction sets and decidable model checking through a satisfaction-preserving translation from Geometric Element Ensembles into the first-order theory of real closed fields.
